description: One build of a builder app (build id from builder_status builds or start_builder_build): status QUEUED, STARTED, SUCCEEDED, FAILED or CANCELED, step = what an AppForShare Linux build is doing now in plain words (waiting for a build server, starting a build server, preparing the Android project, building the release APK and AAB, signing, adding it to AppForShare, making the share link), queueAhead = Linux builds that start before it while every build server is busy (null when one is free for it), credits and refunded, error in plain words, durationMs, artifact (APK and AAB size, APK SHA-256, versionCode, versionName, certSha256 = the app's signing certificate fingerprint) and build = the AppForShare build made from it: url = the install link to share (its page has the QR code, testers and Send to Google Play). log = the end of the build output with secrets removed (Linux builds; only when log: true). A build is SUCCEEDED with build null for a minute while the share link is made: call again. note = something to know in plain words (github: the version went to its own branch with a pull request); runUrl = the run on GitHub (github builds); artifact.kind = apk or ipa. Read only. Every plan with an account.

log.description: Include the end of the build output (default false)

name: builder_build
title: One app builder build
